result: A dead hot-text key is a warning line (key, list file, profile, count) in so, the gate, the plants baseline, hottext-recheck and hottext-repair; it fails only under LIELLA_PROMOTE=1 (the promotion run)
head: c636b1122

gate.affected: ldw-gate1 running (escalated to FULL by the xtask change); ldw-lint1 clippy+static+hottext tests 21 passed in both environments

informational: The direct-tier gate escalates to FULL for any xtask source change (affected.rs maps xtask/src/* to the whole gate), so a tooling story's gate always runs the full suite.
Nothing in the repo sets LIELLA_PROMOTE: the coordinator's next->main promotion run must set LIELLA_PROMOTE=1 for dead keys to fail there.
Survey: static's hottext check, startup_ro, coldbss and the layout start-up contracts had no dead-key failure (layout fails only when none of a file's keys is found, kept as a layout contract).

impact.what: branches whose change inlines a hot-text key away no longer fail so/gate/plants baseline (ruling #5193)

improvement: A tooling change to one xtask module escalates the per-fix gate to FULL; a direct tier for xtask modules (their own unit tests plus the commands that call them) would cut tooling-story gates from the full suite to minutes.
